parts.text: Now you can see why the author is preparing you for holography.
AdS has this very special property:
bulk is causally connected to its timelike boundary.
So it is plausible that specifying data on that boundary contains enormous information about what happens in the bulk.
AdS/CFT will take this much further:
gravity in AdS bulk↔quantum field theory on the AdS boundary.
It is just giving you a causal/geometrical reason why a theory living on the boundary might be intimately connected to what happens inside.

AdS: boundary exists at every t.

new information can later enter from the boundary
